en.name: Hu Tao
en.ability: Each night*, choose a dead player (not yourself or Travellers): you learn 1 good & 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.

revisions.v1: Each night*, choose a dead player (not yourself or Travellers): you learn 1 good & 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.

en.flavor: Life, death, sickness, and old age, the myriad things of heaven and earth, are all within our grasp.
en.otherNightReminder: Wake the Hu Tao up. They point at any dead player. If the chosen player’s character is a Townsfolk or Outsider, show their character token and any Minion or Demon token to the Hu Tao. If the chosen player’s character is a Minion or Demon, show their character token and any Townsfolk or Outsider token to the hu Tao. Then, put the Hu Tao to sleep.
